ZarrSparseMatrix 0.99.0
  • Get started
  • Reference

Sparse matrices stored in a Zarr store

Source: R/ZarrSparseMatrix.R
ZarrSparseMatrix.Rd

The ZarrSparseMatrix class is a DelayedMatrix subclass for representing and operating on a sparse matrix stored in CSR or CSC layout in a Zarr group, as three 1D arrays data, indices and indptr (e.g. the X group of an AnnData .zarr store). It is the Zarr counterpart of HDF5Array::H5SparseMatrix.

# S4 method for class 'ZarrSparseMatrixSeed'
DelayedArray(seed)

# S4 method for class 'ZarrSparseMatrix'
seed(x)

ZarrSparseMatrix(filepath, group, ...)

Arguments

seed

A ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object.

x

A ZarrSparseMatrix object.

filepath

Path to the .zarr store, or a ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object.

group

Name of the group in the store that contains the sparse matrix, e.g. "X".

...

Further arguments passed to ZarrSparseMatrixSeed() (subdata, dim, sparse.layout, dimnames).

Value

A ZarrSparseMatrix object.

Details

All the operations available for DelayedMatrix objects work on ZarrSparseMatrix objects. Data is only read from disk when needed, and subsetting by column (CSC) or by row (CSR) only reads the corresponding elements of data and indices.

See also

ZarrSparseMatrixSeed, HDF5Array::H5SparseMatrix

Examples

## Simulated counts for 200 cells x 100 genes, stored like the X group
## of an AnnData .zarr store (CSR layout)
store <- system.file("extdata", "example.zarr",
                     package="ZarrSparseMatrix")
X <- ZarrSparseMatrix(store, "X")
X

## Genes as rows, cells as columns: transposing the seed gives a
## ZarrSparseMatrix backed by a CSC seed, without reading any data
ZarrSparseMatrix(t(seed(X)))
